description: This file implements an Android.mk rewriter for fixing errors caught by prebuilt ELF checker, including classes and functions for parsing and rewriting build files.

classes.name: Variable
classes.description: Represents the value and locations of a variable in the build file.

classes.name: StashedLines
classes.description: Manages lines temporarily stored during rewriting, allowing modifications before output.

classes.name: Rewriter
classes.description: Main class that rewrites Android.mk files, fixing missing or incorrect build configurations.

methods.name: _report_error
methods.description: Prints an error message to standard error.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes Variable, StashedLines, and Rewriter objects.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a value to a Variable's content.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends the list of lines in StashedLines.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces specific lines in StashedLines with new content.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Outputs all stored lines to a file and resets the stash.

methods.name: _read_prebuilt_file_path
methods.description: Determines the path to the prebuilt ELF file based on variables.

methods.name: _get_module_name_for_dt_needed
methods.description: Converts a DT_NEEDED name to a module name by removing '.so'.

methods.name: _get_module_names_for_dt_needed_entries
methods.description: Converts DT_NEEDED entries into build system module names.

methods.name: _rewrite_build_prebuilt
methods.description: Rewrites build rules for prebuilt ELF files, fixing missing variables or mismatches.

methods.name: _add_var
methods.description: Adds or appends a variable in the internal variable dictionary.

methods.name: _expand_vars
methods.description: Expands variables within a string using current variable values.

methods.name: _clear_vars
methods.description: Clears variables starting with 'LOCAL_' from the internal dictionary.

methods.name: _rewrite_lines
methods.description: Processes lines from the build file, handling includes, variable definitions, and rewriting rules.

methods.name: rewrite
methods.description: Reads the build file, rewrites rules, and outputs the modified content.
